verdict.rationale: The evidence documents APIs for customer screening, per-customer monitoring configuration, case review, audit trails, exports and transaction processing. Nothing shows that an agent can programmatically read fraud posture, propose or manage transaction-monitoring rules such as velocity rules, or update blocklists. Risk-score equation and screening configuration exist but are not shown as rule or list management APIs, and the human escalation applies to alert cases, not to approval gates on rule changes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my fraud posture and manage rules and lists programmatically — propose a velocity rule, update a blocklist — with human approval gates
